admission.justification: The obligation binds several files together, and it is one member of the reading-place family's joint guarantee.

applicability: A `[n]` marker clicked in the document text.
conditions: One code or test target opens in the pane beside the text on a wide screen; several targets are listed first.
At 70rem and narrower the code opens as its own page and Back returns.
exclusions: The document text's own scroll position, which the citation does not move.
statement: Wide citations open in the existing code pane without moving prose; multiple targets are listed first and narrow code navigation retains Back.
